rationale: One off-route segment 18:26-18:38 via the ECP adding 0.80 km (RD-1). It is exempt twice over: an Accident incident 'All lanes closed. Avoid KPE' was reported 18:02 on the optimal KPE route (0 m from it) and KPE was at speed band 1 (RD-4(a)+(b)); and the driver proposed the ECP at 18:10:20, while halted at the first junction after the pickup, and the rider agreed at 18:10:50, before the segment started at 18:26 (RD-5). The rider's 'about $5 more' is consistent with the records: +1.28 km on the meter ($1.81) and 11.2 min more than the estimate, spent crawling on the MCE at band 1 before the turn-off; both the extra distance and the extra time are explained by the closure, so no refund (no_action).
